title: polyfw registry
description:
BSPs and the boards built from them. polyfw also checks each workspace and package through
Cargo metadata.

boards.description: Programmable boards, keyed by board ID, such as sentry-chassis.

propertyNames.description: Lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens, starting with a letter.

bsps.description: Board support packages, keyed by BSP ID, such as dm-mc02.

propertyNames.description: Lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens, starting with a letter.

config.description: Project-wide tool options. BSPs and boards describe the firmware separately.

bin.description: Firmware binary target; omit only when the package declares exactly one binary.

bsp.description: ID of a BSP in this registry.

description.description: Name shown in board lists and prompts.

package.description: Firmware package in the consuming workspace. It must have a library target.

chip.description: probe-rs chip name for hardware commands and VS Code, such as STM32H723VGTx.

workspace.description: Cargo workspace directory, relative to the operating project root, without `..`.

local-dependencies.description:
Directory globs selecting reachable Cargo path dependencies for fmt, lint, test, verify
and detailed info. Relative patterns start at the directory holding polyfw.toml;
absolute paths and leading `..` may include external packages. Match each package's
canonical Cargo.toml parent directory: `shared` selects only shared/Cargo.toml,
`shared/*` selects immediate package directories, and `shared/**` includes shared and all
descendants. Existing literal directory prefixes are canonicalized. Selected firmware
is always included; registry and Git packages never are.
Omission defaults to ["./**"]. An empty array selects no dependencies, valid unmatched
patterns select nothing, and invalid globs are errors. `..` must precede any wildcard.

vscode.description: VS Code launch generation when a selection is saved or cleared.

enabled.description:
Manage the entire .vscode/launch.json when saving or clearing a selection.
Defaults to true. When false, leave any existing launch.json untouched.
